title: Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs: Invoicing, Due Dates, Late Fees and the Application of Payments
content:
Accounts receivable note on the program balance of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs.

The program price is invoiced on the tier's billing frequency, and extra sets, shipping, lamps, laboratory work, duct cleaning and complaint investigations beyond the included counts are invoiced in the period they arise. Each invoice falls due the tier's payment term after the invoice date, counted in calendar days with the invoice day excluded and the due day included, and an invoice unpaid past its due day carries the tier's late fee for each month or part month it stays unpaid. Credits are applied to the next program invoice. Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid invoice unless the owner names one.

### The due date

The due date is the day that falls the tier's payment term in calendar days after the invoice date, the invoice day itself not counted and the due day counted as the last day of the term. On hypothetical inputs, an invoice dated 2026-03-01 under 30-day terms falls due on 2026-03-31; under 45-day terms the same invoice falls due on 2026-04-15. An invoice is past its due day from the day after the due day.

### The late fee

The late fee for one month is the invoice amount multiplied by the tier's late fee rate per month, rounded to the cent, and it is charged for each month or part month the invoice stays unpaid past its due day; a part month counts as a whole month.

*Worked on hypothetical inputs.* An invoice of 2,400 USD at a late fee rate of 1.5 percent per month carries a late fee of 36.00 USD for each month or part month it stays unpaid: one day past due is one part month and carries 36.00 USD; a month and one day past due is two months, and carries 72.00 USD in all. At a rate of 1.0 percent per month the same invoice carries 24.00 USD per month or part month.

### What is invoiced when

| Item | When it is invoiced |
|---|---|
| The program price | On the tier's billing frequency |
| Extra filter sets beyond the included sets | In the period they arise |
| Shipping | In the period it arises |
| Ultraviolet lamps beyond the included lamps | In the period they arise |
| Laboratory work | In the period it arises |
| Duct cleaning | In the period it arises |
| Complaint investigations beyond the included count | In the period they arise |

### Credits and payments

A credit issued on the program is applied to the next program invoice. A payment is applied to the oldest unpaid invoice on the program unless the owner names the invoice it is for, in which case it is applied to that invoice.

### The program balance as the records show it

The balance due under a program is the amount the owner currently owes: charges increase it, and payments and credits reduce it. The figure on the program is the running result of the charge, payment and credit entries recorded against it.
